label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75 a.2…: Every body constitutively has some bodily nature
locator: I q.75 a.2 co.: Omne autem corpus habet aliquam naturam determinatam
interpretation: Every body has a determinate nature. A selected bodily-nature witness is naturally present in that body. This is constitutive possession, not a represented concept.
